in_marathi.name: Himank
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Himank is derived from the Sanskrit word 'himan', which means 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a divine entity and is worshipped as a symbol of fertility and prosperity. The name Himank is thus believed to be auspicious and is given to babies as a blessing from the gods for a prosperous and blessed life.
